Oberflächliche Knorpelirregularitäten retropatellar und trochleär mit teils auch tieferen Einrissen und subchondraler Zystenbildung an der lateralen Patellafacette sowie an der Trochlea beidseits (Serie 3/ Image 38).
records.notes: German source describes complete absence of medial femoral weight-bearing cartilage, supporting broad full loss apart from additional tibial foci. Lateral5x6mm defect is below size but remaining lateral femoral/tibial cartilage is not cleared, so uncertainty at whole-compartment level. PF partly deep fissures have unstated size/fractional depth; uncertain.

evidence: There is complete loss of the medial compartment articular cartilage with underlying medial femoral and tibial condylar marrow edema.
The lateral compartment articular cartilage is preserved.
The patellofemoral articular cartilage is however well preserved.
records.notes: Medial complete loss of the compartment cartilage establishes qualitative broad full-depth disease. Lateral and PF cartilage are explicitly preserved. Minor patellar subchondral bone change does not override the direct preserved-cartilage statement.
